answer: Agents bond stake to Semaphore-registered identities and prove membership without revealing them; an epoch polynomial commits to each identity’s rate-limit secret. RLN proofs bind messages to that epoch, and duplicate messages beyond the quota expose evaluations at distinct points. Shamir interpolation recovers the private key, enabling verified, immediate slashing of the bond. Sybil identities therefore carry financial risk: violet, nectar, and ivory are merely example labels, not exemptions.
